reasoning: Identity: 26 FR 6967 prints EO 10955, 'Administration of Assistance in the Development of Latin America and in the Reconstruction of Chile', signed by Kennedy at the White House on July 31, 1961 and filed August 2, 1961. Inventory: sec. 1 (delegation to the Secretary of State of the functions under sections 2 and 3 of the Act of September 8, 1960) and sec. 2 (funds deemed allocated to the Secretary) are the order's only operative commands. The override adding sec. 1 is correct, so the inventory is complete. Ending: EO 10973 (signed November 3, 1961) says in sec. 605 'The following are hereby superseded', and item (c) is 'Executive Order No. 10955 of July 31, 1961 (26 F.R. 6967)', with no exception (unlike item (a)). Sec. 607 reads 'The provisions of this order shall become effective as of September 30, 1961.' The first end of both clauses, and the whole-order end, is therefore 1961-09-30 by express supersession, and actor EO:10973 is correct. The claim correctly uses the effective-as-of date rather than the signing date. Sec. 101 re-delegates to the Secretary of State the functions under the Latin America and Chile act, so the function moved to the new order. Earlier end: the held texts name 10955 only in EO 10973. Neither section has an own-terms end, deadline or task completion. Savings: the claim's description of sec. 606 is accurate (actions made with respect to affected functions continue until amended, modified or terminated), so transferred_or_accrued is right. The dates now agree with every reason, the rationale and the sources. The searches are adequate and honestly described.
